calibration.reason: No curated known-good or known-bad research-refine proposals were supplied.

problem_anchor.bottom_line_problem: On externally supplied person-indexed pose tracks, determine whether identity-indexed, window-local soft routing over shared fast, medium, and slow response experts can count each person's repetitions under asynchronous and within-track pace changes without using human per-person count or period annotations in the counting objective, while reconstructing one continuous response and decoding exactly once per identity.
problem_anchor.must_solve_bottleneck: The system must identify one response event per primitive physical repetition, specialize the three shared experts by relative local tempo, prevent cross-person state leakage, and prevent overlap-window double counting without consulting evaluator labels.
problem_anchor.non_goals: This work does not introduce MRAC, person-wise output, pose counting, tracking, temporal windows, phase learning, mixture-of-experts, ACF/FFT, PAMS-TCC, NOLA, or peak detection. It does not claim first, annotation-free, label-free, end-to-end, constant-time, or state of the art.
problem_anchor.constraints: ICASSP 2027; four technical pages plus a references-only fifth page; two RTX A6000 GPUs; a partial GT-bbox-assisted supplied-track MultiRep train/development cache; no test, sealed, heldout, or historical result access; all human count, period, density, and cycle-boundary fields remain in an evaluator-only vault; all semantic review is same-family provisional GPT-5.6-Sol.
problem_anchor.success_condition: The method may advance only if a frozen synthetic topology gate establishes one primitive orbit per response winding, all seven architecture invariants pass, every expert demonstrates diagonal tempo specialization, and a three-seed supplied-track development pilot improves the strongest matched nonlocal/control model under piecewise tempo drift without materially degrading stationary counting.

method_specificity.weakness: The degree-one teacher, local tempo cue, expert class, loss indexing, constants, and checkpoint precedence are not frozen to an executable interface.
method_specificity.fix: Freeze exact tensor and mask contracts, one expert architecture, teacher/code architecture, complete-orbit winding evaluator, source-frequency grid, reliable-window rule, fully indexed losses, constants, and deterministic checkpoint precedence; remove positive-variation minimization.

contribution_quality.weakness: A teacher, routing mechanism, and reconstruction-ordering story create three substantial contributions despite the stated one-claim budget.
contribution_quality.fix: Make cue-only local-tempo selection of specialized shared response scales the sole paper claim; treat the teacher as a passed supervision contract and NOLA/one-decode as fixed correctness plumbing.

feasibility.weakness: No current tree implements TempoRAC; the label-mixed cache is ineligible for training; the nuisance K4 schema is open; and the one-week estimate undercounts the teacher, spectral cue, state instrumentation, decoder, and firewall work.
feasibility.fix: Stage specification, CPU synthetic gates, deterministic invariant tests, feature/vault receipts, a one-seed sanity run, and only then the bounded three-seed pilot; omit optional PAMS initialization and continuity loss initially.

validation_focus.weakness: Retraining every router arm confounds routing with optimization, the one-head match is underspecified, and the handoff list is broader than the core causal proof.
validation_focus.fix: Use same-frozen-response interventions over local, global, uniform, blocked, and shuffled gates; report a held-out expert-by-tempo matrix against a parameter/FLOP-matched one-head control; test NOLA ordering on the identical response tensor.

venue_readiness.weakness: The residual novelty is unproven, TWCRAC overlap is unresolved, there are zero eligible results, and the teacher/decoder contracts are open.
venue_readiness.fix: Close the response-unit and peak gates, obtain one non-additive routing result against matched controls, and keep literature/title, server, and paper authorization as separate later decisions.

gap.summary: The gap is caused by an operationally unclosed degree-one teacher, an undefended sparse-pulse threshold contract, a causally confounded router comparison, and paper-level component sprawl rather than by drift or missing trendy components.

degree_one_teacher.ideal_argument: A true continuous left inverse on a complete primitive S1 orbit gives injectivity; orientation can then select degree +1.
degree_one_teacher.blocking_issue: Finite-sample approximate reconstruction, correspondence, orientation, and per-edge alias losses do not force circular coverage or a +1 closing-edge winding. Minimum positive phase variation rewards degree-zero arc compression, and a dense double winding can satisfy the per-edge alias bound.
degree_one_teacher.minimal_fix: Freeze learner-hidden synthetic primitive coordinates, include the closing edge, measure signed winding, coverage, collision, seam continuity, and reconstruction on held-out resamplers, attack degree 0, -1, +2, harmonic, symmetric, code-bypass, and decoder-bypass solutions, and remove minimum-positive-variation checkpoint selection.
degree_one_teacher.failure_action: Reject the no-human-count/period response route without label-based repair.

one_final_peak_pass.blocking_issue: Sparse impulse BCE plus soft expert mixing and NOLA does not guarantee one threshold-0.5 connected component per teacher event or a below-threshold valley between events.
one_final_peak_pass.minimal_fix: Add a teacher-derived pulse/valley margin objective and held-out threshold-0.5 split/merge/NOLA gate with deterministic gap, plateau, spacing, duplicate-clock, padding, pause, and grid-shift semantics.
one_final_peak_pass.failure_action: Reject the strict peak contract and TempoRAC route; do not silently replace it with an integral decoder.

cue_only_routing_and_matched_experts.strength: A nontrainable cue-only gate prevents latent bypass, and matched shared experts make specialization falsifiable.
cue_only_routing_and_matched_experts.blocking_issue: The specialization and fusion losses can drive all experts toward the same target, the p-star-to-anchor mapping is not exact, and separately retrained router controls confound routing with optimization.
required_evidence: Each expert is diagonal-best on an unseen-resampler expert-by-tempo matrix.
Local, global, uniform, blocked, and shuffled gates are intervened on the same frozen expert response tensor.
Cue shuffling removes the local-over-global advantage.
The three-expert system beats an exact total-parameter and FLOP-matched one-head control under drift without material stationary degradation.

gates.name: feature_vault_firewall
gates.closure: Feature-only shards, separate vault, pre-deserialization forbidden-key rejection, source-component manifest, and hash receipts.

gates.name: degree_one_teacher
gates.closure: Generator hashes, hidden primitive coordinates, complete-orbit closing-edge metrics, attacks, tolerances, architecture, and checkpoint precedence.

gates.name: seven_invariants
gates.closure: Instrumented object-ID, parameter/FLOP, private-buffer, local-cue, fusion-order, NOLA-coverage, and decoder-call assertions.

gates.name: routing_specialization
gates.closure: Same-frozen-response interventions, exact stratum-anchor map, resampler bins, one-head match, paired unit, and decision rule.

gates.name: pulse_nola_peak
gates.closure: Pulse margins, threshold gate, spacing domain, invalid-gap semantics, grid shifts, split/merge oracle, and exactly-once call trace.

gates.name: supplied_track_pilot
gates.closure: All earlier gates plus the frozen three-seed source-component bootstrap evaluator.

simplification_opportunities: Delete L_cont from the first implementation.
Keep PAMS-TCC initialization out of the canonical first run and use it only as a later control.
Use one predeclared irregular-clock routing distribution, preferably NUDFT, and retain ACF as a diagnostic unless a necessity gate justifies fusion.
Treat positive NOLA and one decode as fixed correctness operators rather than a supporting contribution.

modernization_opportunities.reason: LLM, VLM, diffusion, RL, or inference-time search does not naturally resolve degree, pulse, or identity-state identifiability and would worsen contribution sprawl.

future_drift_triggers: Promoting the teacher into a separate primary contribution without a new review.
Replacing the required one-final-peak-pass with an integral count decoder under the same TempoRAC identity.

remaining_action_items.action: Freeze the teacher topology contract and remove minimum-positive-variation selection.
Close the threshold-0.5 peak contract with teacher-derived pulse/valley margins and held-out split/merge/NOLA gates.
Write one executable interface sheet covering tensors, masks, clocks, expert class, frequency grid, reliability, losses, constants, checkpoint precedence, and call traces.
Build and receipt the physical feature/vault boundary and close the nuisance-only K4 schema before data-bearing training.
Make routing causality a same-frozen-response intervention and define the exact matched one-head control.
Collapse the paper story to one routing claim; keep the teacher as prerequisite and NOLA/one-decode as correctness plumbing.
Keep novelty, title, server, and paper authorization separate and unresolved.

verdict.rationale: The direction is on-anchor and revisable, but the response unit, peak decoder, causal router proof, and gate stack are not yet executable as claimed.
